question: Which divine power protects the speaker's breasts through the klīṃ-kṛṣṇa mantra?
premises: The heart-lotus queen is invoked as protector
The mantra klīṃ-kṛṣṇa is addressed to her
The breasts are named as the protected body part
inference: The heart-lotus queen, invoked by klīṃ-kṛṣṇa, protects the speaker's breasts.
plain_english: May the queen of the heart-lotus, invoked as klīṃ-kṛṣṇa, protect my breasts.
